shots.text: The Sundered Heart had reached the inner wall when a white light came up the east road.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Battle at the inner wall. Far down the east road, a small white light.

shots.text: It was Oswin. He had fallen through the Gate at the start of the war and walked back under the world, through the Hollow, and climbed up out of the Rift. The Unbound would not go near his lantern.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A tall figure in glowing white robes walking up the east road through the horde; grey-eyed Unbound shrink back and fade as he passes.

shots.text: Hello, Ysolde. I'm sorry I'm late. I found this at the bottom of the Rift. I think it's yours.
shots.speaker: oswin
shots.art_note: Oswin, white-haired, standing tall at the foot of the wall below the Queen, holding up the last white shard of the Sunstone.

shots.text:
He climbed the Spire, set the last piece in the Sunstone's frame, and lit it with his lantern.

The dark sank back into the Rift, and the sun came up over Solenne for the first time in months.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Oswin raising the lantern. Light pours up into the Sunstone frame above the city; it blazes. Real dawn floods the battlefield. (Game lighting: night to dawn.) Oswin joins as a hero.

shots.text: The Unbound around the walls burned in it. Only the Sundered Heart kept coming.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Grey shapes flaring and falling in the sunlight; the Sundered Heart pushing on through the glare.
